en.intro_text: A clean Hangar starter with separate frontend and backend structure.
en.frontend_card_body: Build screens in pages/, reuse UI in components/, and keep shared helpers in lib/.
en.backend_card_body: Compose routers in backend/main.py, put endpoints in routers/, and move business logic into services/.
en.data_card_body: Start without seeded tables. Add app-scoped data only when your feature needs it.
en.health_fallback: Backend status is not available yet.
en.footer_note: Use this starter when you want a clean folder structure without demo business logic.

zh.intro_text: 这是一个干净的 Hangar 起步模板，前后端结构分离。
zh.frontend_card_body: 在 pages/ 中构建页面，在 components/ 中复用 UI，在 lib/ 中放共享帮助代码。
zh.backend_card_body: 在 backend/main.py 中组合路由，把接口放进 routers/，把业务逻辑放进 services/。
zh.data_card_body: 默认不预置数据表。只有在功能需要时再添加应用级数据。
zh.health_loading: 正在检查后端健康状态...
zh.footer_note: 当你只想要清晰的文件结构而不想先删除演示业务逻辑时，请使用这个模板。
